source='''def transform(grid):
    # Mirror the original grid in all directions to form a 3x3 array of tiles.
    h = [row[::-1] for row in grid]
    v = grid[::-1]
    hv = [row[::-1] for row in v]
    tiles = [[hv, v, hv], [h, grid, h], [hv, v, hv]]
    out = []
    for tile_row in tiles:
        for r in range(len(grid)):
            out.append([cell for tile in tile_row for cell in tile[r]])
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task096495d5', program_path)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
print('demo checks:', [mod.transform(x)==y for x,y in demos])
answer=mod.transform(test)
